```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  include = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)  # for data wrangling and visualization
library(patchwork)  # for combining multiple plots
library(BrailleR)   # for brailleR tables
GoSighted()

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 16))

set.seed(123)

# helper functions adapted from Navarro and Foxcroft
# ---- normal ---- #
plot_normal_interval <- function (lb, ub, m = 0, s = 1, xaxis = "z") {
  ll = -4*s+m
  ul = 4*s+m
  ggplot(data = data.frame(x = seq(ll, ul, 1)), aes(x)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean =  m, sd = s), col="darkgray", geom = "area",
                  fill = "steelblue", alpha=0.8, xlim = c(lb, ub)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean = m, sd = s), col="darkgray", linewidth=1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(lb, ub), col="gray")+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(ll, ul, s)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggtitle(paste("Shaded area = ", sprintf("%.2f", 100*(pnorm(ub, m, s)-pnorm(lb, m, s))), "%")) +
    xlab(xaxis) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}
plot_normal_lessthan <- function (ub, m = 0, s = 1, xaxis = "z") {
  ll = -4*s+m
  ul = 4*s+m
  ggplot(data = data.frame(x = seq(ll, ul, 1)), aes(x)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean =  m, sd = s), col="darkgray", geom = "area",
                  fill = "grey", alpha=0.8, xlim = c(ll, ub)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean = m, sd = s), col="darkgray", linewidth=1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(ll, ul, s)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggtitle(paste("Shaded area = ", sprintf("%.2f", 100*(pnorm(ub, m, s))), "%")) +
    xlab(xaxis) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}
plot_normal_greaterthan <- function (lb, m = 0, s = 1, xaxis = "z") {
  ll = -4*s+m
  ul = 4*s+m
  ggplot(data = data.frame(x = seq(ll, ul, 1)), aes(x)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean =  m, sd = s), col="darkgray", geom = "area",
                  fill = "grey", alpha=0.8, xlim = c(lb, ul)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean = m, sd = s), col="darkgray", linewidth=1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(ll, ul, s)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggtitle(paste("Shaded area = ", sprintf("%.2f", 100*(1-pnorm(lb, m, s))), "%")) +
    xlab(xaxis) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}
plot_normal_greaterthan_or_lessthan <- function (ub, lb, m = 0, s = 1, xaxis = "z") {
  ll = -4*s+m
  ul = 4*s+m
  ggplot(data = data.frame(x = seq(ll, ul, 1)), aes(x)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean =  m, sd = s), col="grey", geom = "area",
                  fill = "grey", alpha=0.8, xlim = c(lb, ul)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean =  m, sd = s), col="grey", geom = "area",
                  fill = "grey", alpha=0.8, xlim = c(ll, ub)) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, n = 1000, args = list(mean = m, sd = s), col="darkgray", linewidth=1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(ll, ul, s)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggtitle(paste("Shaded area = ", sprintf("%.2f", 100*((1-pnorm(lb, m, s))+pnorm(ub, m, s))), "%")) +
    xlab(xaxis) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}
```

```{r, include=TRUE}
#| label: fig-normal-intervals
#| fig-cap: "Standard Normal Distribution and the 68-95-99.7 Rule"
#| fig-alt: "Standard normal distributions where the x-axis shows the z-scores from -4 to 4. From top to bottom panels, three plots show the standard normal distribution with shaded areas are lines corresponding to the intervals -1 to 1, -2 to 2, and -3 to 3. The top panel shows that the interval from -1 to 1 covers 68.27% of the data, the middle panel shows that the interval from -2 to 2 covers 95.45% of the data, and the bottom panel shows that the interval from -3 to 3 covers 99.73% of the data."
#| fig-height: 10

plot_normal_interval(-1, 1) /
plot_normal_interval(-2, 2) /
plot_normal_interval(-3, 3)
```


```{r, include=TRUE}
#| label: fig-standard-normal-dist
#| fig-cap: "The Standard Normal Distribution"
#| fig-alt: "The standard normal distribution with mean of 0 and standard deviation of 1. The x-axis shows scores from -5 to 5, and the y-axis shows the density. There are lines at -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, and 3, creating intervals. The labels indicate the probability of a score falling within each interval: 0.001, 0.021, 0.136, 0.341, 0.341, 0.136, 0.021, and 0.001."

dnorm_vec <- dnorm(seq(-5,5,.1),mean=0,sd=1)
x_range   <- seq(-5,5,.1)
t_df<-data.frame(x_range,dnorm_vec)

ggplot(t_df, aes(x=x_range,y=dnorm_vec))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-3,-2,-1,1,2,3))+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Density")+
  xlab("Score") +
  ggtitle("Standard Normal Distribution") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-5,5,1))+
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=-.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(0,1),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(0,1),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))+
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(0,1),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(0,1),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))+
    geom_label(data = data.frame(x=-1.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(1,2),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(1,2),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))+
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=1.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(1,2),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(1,2),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label)) + 
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=-2.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(2,3),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(2,3),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))+
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=2.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(2,3),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(2,3),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))+ 
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=-3.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(3,4),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(3,4),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))+
  geom_label(data = data.frame(x=3.5, y=.3,
            label=round(pnorm(c(3,4),0,1)[2]-pnorm(c(3,4),0,1)[1], digits=3)), 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label))
```
